verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her Q (Broken Wings) chain or stand still for W (Ki Burst), but you win the extended fight once her E (Valor) shield is down and your R (Unstoppable Force) resets the fight.

brief.thesis: Riven's entire combo depends on landing W (Ki Burst) to stun you before she dumps her Q (Broken Wings) charges and empowered autos; if you deny that stun window with spacing and only commit E (Ground Slam) when she's already inside 400 range, she has no way to force damage onto you. The 53.3% win rate over 1122 games reflects that Malphite's kit directly answers her all-in shape once you play the punish correctly instead of trading blow-for-blow.

theirWindow.when: Valor (E) and Ki Burst (W) both ready
theirWindow.what: This is her all-in: she'll Valor in, Ki Burst to stun, then dump Broken Wings (Q) charges and empowered autos. Do not stand in W (Ki Burst) range at 260 units when both are up — back off a step or pre-emptively E (Ground Slam) the moment she closes to 400 to clip her before the stun lands.

yourWindow.what: She has no gap-close or damage-block left, so this is when you walk up and land Q (Seismic Shard) for the slow plus W (Brutal Strikes) autos. Do not blow E (Ground Slam) here if she's out of range — save it for when she re-engages.

powerCurve.note: Ki Burst stun punishes early trades hard

start.why: Not actually in the measured data for this lane, so default to the listed Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion if you want to match the recorded 50.4% line — it covers the early poke and sustain against her short-trade pokes without needing mana you don't use much.

boots.why: 85.2% pick rate at 53.4% win rate — the flat damage reduction blunts her empowered auto-attack bursts from Runic Blade stacks far better than the alternative.

core.why: Highest-winrate first core item (58% in the top path) and gives the armor your E (Ground Slam) scales off of, plus waveclear to punish her all-in misses.
Appears in every top-performing core path; the attack speed debuff from E (Ground Slam) plus Thornmail's grievous wounds shuts down her sustain from Runic Blade autos.
Part of the 58% and 58.7% win-rate paths; the attack speed slow stacks with E (Ground Slam) to make her empowered auto-reliant combo nearly inert.

situational.when: she is building AD/true damage heavy and you need a magic shield buffer for her burst windows
you are ahead and want your R (Unstoppable Force) and E (Ground Slam) to hit harder in skirmishes rather than just scaling tankiness
she rushes lifesteal or sustain items and you need the grievous wounds earlier than Thornmail completes

runes.keystoneWhy: The 55.9% win-rate page's keystone rewards you for staying in extended autoattack range, which matches the plan of out-sustaining her short trades rather than all-inning; at master tier, players switch to Arcane Comet (Sorcery) instead, which suits players who want to punish her E (Valor) engage with burst poke rather than scale through sustain.

summoners.why: Teleport is the overwhelming pick at 76.5% with a 53.4% win rate, letting you reset waveclear and item timers in a lane where you're outscaling rather than all-inning; Ignite is a viable alternative at 19.2% pick if you want to punish her low-sustain all-in attempts directly.

playing.title: Hold E for her Valor engage
playing.detail: Don't throw Ground Slam (E, 7s cooldown, 400 range) preemptively — wait until she's committed inside 400 range with Valor (E) so the attack speed reduction actually disrupts her follow-up empowered autos.

playing.title: Poke with Q when Valor is down
playing.detail: Seismic Shard (Q, 8s cooldown, 625 range) outranges her entire kit when her E (Valor) is on cooldown — use this window to slow and chip her without any risk of a stun trade.

playing.title: Never fight into her shield
playing.detail: Valor (E) blocks incoming damage while active — OP.GG's own read confirms this: do not commit Q, E, or autos the instant you see her dash, or you're wasting cooldowns on a shield.

playing.title: Track Ki Burst for all-in timing
playing.detail: Ki Burst (W, cooldown 11/10/9/8/7s) is her only stun and scales down fast with levels — respect it more at level 1-2 and less by level 6+ when she's cycling it faster but you have more HP to eat it.

playing.title: Use R to punish her cooldown dumps
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (R, cooldown 130/115/100/80/80s, 1000 range) threatens a knockup the moment she's spent Broken Wings (Q) charges and Valor (E) — look for this after she whiffs an all-in.

playing.title: Brutal Strikes for extended trades
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes (W, 14s cooldown, 400 range) boosts your Armor and AD for the duration — activate it before you walk up to trade, not reactively, so the armor is already up when her empowered autos land.

playing.title: Don't contest level 1-2 skirmishes
playing.detail: Her Ki Burst stun is at its lowest cooldown relative to her power spike early — play passive near your tower until Granite Shield's passive recharge and your own levels catch up around level 3-5.

brief.patchCaveat: All win rates, pick rates, item paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning connecting those numbers to specific ability interactions is this brief's own analysis, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] when Riven closes in to reduce her attack speed and not allow her to use her full combo. Do not try to deal damage when Riven has her shield.
